reasoning_trace.detail: Bhashini translated Hindi query 'सरकारी कार्यालय और स्मार्ट सिटी...'. Identified IP CCTV Surveillance System.
Matched IS 16165:2014 for CCTV systems alongside MeitY mandatory CRS hardware specifications.
Knowledge graph verified safety requirements under IS 13252 (Part 1) and test protocol under IS 16910.
MeitY CCTV Security Order 2018 mandates trusted source compliance and BIS CRS R-number.

plain_language_explanation.text: For IP CCTV surveillance systems in smart cities and public offices, the governing standard is **IS 16165:2014** with mandatory MeitY CRS hardware safety certification under **IS 13252 (Part 1)**. Cameras must be certified for ONVIF compliance and sourced from trusted cybersecurity-audited manufacturers.
plain_language_explanation.bhashini_translated_text: सरकारी कार्यालयों और स्मार्ट सिटी के लिए आईपी सीसीटीवी निगरानी प्रणाली हेतु मुख्य मानक **IS 16165:2014** और हार्डवेयर सुरक्षा के लिए **IS 13252 (Part 1)** अनिवार्य है।

compliance_checklist.item: Mandatory MeitY BIS CRS Registration (IS 13252 Part 1) on all cameras
compliance_checklist.action_required: Verify valid 8-digit R-number before technical qualification.

compliance_checklist.item: ONVIF Profile S/G/T Interoperability Compliance per IS 16910
compliance_checklist.action_required: Demand official ONVIF member certification report.
Ensure NDA and STQC security test certificate are attached.

staleness_risk.message: All standards are active and compliant with MeitY electronics mandates.
